title: Lemon Studio Michael Lane Edition 2026.11.04.9
notes:
- The Lemon live monitor groups audio load, memory use and underruns with a triggered master-output oscilloscope and stereo peak meters. Compact and classic meter layouts remain selectable.
- Clone (Complete) creates independent channel and pattern copies, including instrument state, note expression, channel automation and matching Playlist placements. Undo and redo restore the musical parts.
- The Piano Roll marks scale roots on the keyboard. Select All follows the focused channel, and D can duplicate notes when typing-to-play is off. Shift-dragging with Brush copies a selection, and right-drag erases notes across fast pointer moves.
- Lemon Sampler supports per-note drive. Browser auditions offer boost and clipping, and the sampler locate button reveals the source in the Browser. Saved instrument presets can be auditioned using rendered middle-C previews.
- New synth windows open with settings collapsed. Step gaps ignore clicks. Drag the metronome and browser preview destinations vertically in Audio Settings. Mixer assignment reuses an existing recording lane.
- Tape saturation adds wow, flutter and signal-dependent hiss. Streamed sampler playback and partial mixer repainting use less processing.
- Plugins without a native interface expose their controls in the Browser. Preset menus include programs advertised by VST2, VST3 and CLAP plugins. Help stays accessible through an overflow button on narrow toolbars.
